title: Account
notYoursText: You can only manage the account you are signed in with.

email.title: Change your email
email.intro: We'll send a confirmation link to the new address. Your email changes once you open it.

password.title: Change your password
password.intro: We'll email a link to {{email}} to choose a new password. The link works once.
password.failed: Couldn't send the link. Please try again.

signOut.label: Sign out
signOut.title: Sign out?
signOut.text: You'll need your email and password to sign in again on this device.

import.title: Import your history
import.subtitle: Ratings, watched titles and watchlist from another service go into {{name}}'s profile, and its recommendations start from them.
import.tvHint: On a TV? Files can't be picked with a remote: open {{url}} on your phone or computer, signed in to this account.
import.entryValue: Bring your ratings and watched titles for better recommendations.

errors.unknown_format: We couldn't read that file. Upload the export from Letterboxd (.zip) or IMDb (.csv).
errors.too_big: That file is too big (10 MB at most).

letterboxd.name: Letterboxd
letterboxd.step1: On letterboxd.com, open Settings, then Data, and select Export your data.
letterboxd.step2: Upload the .zip file here, no need to unzip it.

imdb.name: IMDb
imdb.step1: On imdb.com, open Your ratings, select ⋯ then Export. IMDb tells you when the file is ready.
imdb.step2: Do the same with your Watchlist if you want it in My List.
imdb.step3: Upload the .csv files here (several at once is fine).

done.title: Import done
done.nothingNew: Nothing new: all of it was already here.

history.title: Watch history
history.subtitle: What {{name}} watched here, newest first.
history.pauseHint: While it's paused, what this profile watches isn't saved: not here, not in Continue watching, not in recommendations.
history.clearText: Everything {{name}} watched is removed, with Continue watching and what it taught the recommendations. Likes and My List stay.
history.emptyText: Titles watched on this profile show up here.
history.pausedText: Nothing is saved while it's paused. Turn it back on above whenever you like.
